title: Children of the King
story:
A little girl visited a palace during a school trip.

She admired the beautiful halls, the royal portraits, and the magnificent throne.

Looking around in amazement, she whispered,

“It must be wonderful to belong to a king's family.”

Her teacher smiled and replied,

“Do you know something even more wonderful?

When we trust in Jesus, God welcomes us into His own family.”

The girl thought about those words all day.

She realized that being a child of God was a far greater privilege than belonging to any earthly kingdom.

Our Heavenly Father loves us, cares for us, and calls us His sons and daughters.

We never have to earn His acceptance.

Through Christ, we are welcomed into His family forever.

As His children, we can confidently come to Him, knowing we are deeply loved.
life_lesson: Through Jesus Christ, God adopts us into His family. We are His beloved sons and daughters forever.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for welcoming me into Your family.

Thank You for calling me Your child.

Help me to live each day with confidence in Your love and acceptance.

May my life reflect the joy of belonging to You.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
What does it mean to you that God calls you His child?

How does being part of God's family change the way you see yourself?

How can you live today as a child of the King?
verse: And, 'I will be a Father to you, and you will be My sons and daughters,' says the Lord Almighty.
